verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own browser configuration docs say Browserbase-launched sessions can run in one of four regions, letting users keep session data in a required jurisdiction. Local and CDP-attached browsers also keep browser data on the user's own machine. The caveat is that region choice only applies when sessions run on Browserbase infrastructure, and the server-side cache of act/observe/extract results has no documented residency. Missing for 10: residency controls for server-side cached results and LLM-processed data, a list of the four regions or residency guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
